en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside cityscape with several large institutional buildings and a prominent round tower and walls on the ridge in the background. The foreground has gardens and smaller buildings. Greek text is printed at the upper left, and French text identifying the place as an Ottoman hospital in Salonique appears at the upper right. A website watermark (elia.org.gr) is overprinted at the bottom right.
